name: heldout_harmless
note: Unambiguously benign, never used in extraction. Two roles: showing baseline refusal is near zero (a model that refuses these is broken, and the injection result would mean nothing), and showing that injecting the refusal direction drives refusal up on prompts with nothing objectionable in them — the more striking half of the demo, the direction doing the work rather than the content of the prompt.
